name: Screen-space Halos (Internal)
definition: A technique to render halos over non-background pixels (internal halos) by analyzing depth discontinuities and using average depth to modulate halo intensity, preventing halo rendering where depth variation is minimal.
summary: Screen-space Halos (Internal) renders halos over opaque volume structures by analyzing depth discontinuities to provide shape cues through color blending, rather than just darkening.
